summary: yum_repository adds or removes repos on RPM systems (use ini_file to tweak existing ones). Editing removes comments, sorts parameters, deletes empty files, and removal may leave metadata cache until yum clean all.
questions: How do I add a yum repository with Ansible?
Why did my repo file lose its comments?
How do I clean metadata after removing a yum repo?
How do I edit one option in an existing .repo file?

answer_card.title: Manage YUM repositories
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.yum_repository` adds/removes repos in `.repo` files. To update an existing definition, `community.general.ini_file` may be better.
- Comments are removed; params sorted alphabetically; section order kept.
- Empty repo files are deleted.
- After removal, run `yum clean all` (e.g. via a handler).
